what_went_wrong.finding: The original review path allowed generic free text and did not require disposition-specific codes, reproduction steps, expected behavior, acceptance criteria or exact evidence references.
what_went_wrong.impact: Operator decisions were not sufficiently reproducible or diagnosable.

what_went_wrong.finding: The Candidate Detail panel did not initially expose exact queue, fingerprint, source-lineage and structural-comparison context needed to decide two deferred objects.
what_went_wrong.impact: The operator could not distinguish a market-description problem from a presentation or missing-context problem.

what_went_wrong.finding: One deferred object was ultimately rejected for chronology inconsistency.
what_went_wrong.impact: At least one selected object was not internally coherent enough to support a reliable market description.

what_went_wrong.finding: One object required a third review pass exposing medoid identity, component distance, outlier threshold, overlap status and LONG_PERSISTENCE derivation before workflow acceptance.
what_went_wrong.impact: The underlying structural record was reproducible, but the initial description and panel were not self-explanatory.

what_went_wrong.finding: Only six queue-promoted objects were reviewed while 202 candidates were suppressed.
what_went_wrong.impact: The reviewed set is too small and selection-biased for a population-level consistency claim.

what_went_wrong.finding: The June source is explicitly GAPPED and no claim-level benchmark against exact price paths was produced.

computational_reproducibility.basis: Byte-identical deterministic rerun for the exact governed input and frozen code/rule identities.

lineage_and_evidence_integrity.basis: Exact SHA-256 links and Ed25519 SSHSIG verification passed for the corrective evidence chain.

review_workflow_reliability.basis: Structured v2, CORR2 and CORR3 corrections closed missing-field and missing-context defects without another machine replay.

internal_structural_consistency.basis: One chronology-inconsistent object was rejected; one object became internally reconcilable only after exact structural comparison was exposed.

external_market_description_validity.basis: No immutable claim-to-price truth matrix, contradiction audit or exact candidate-window benchmark is present in the repository packet.

population_level_consistency.basis: Six promoted objects and zero stratified suppressed-object reviews cannot establish consistency across the 208-candidate population.

overall_answer.question: Does the system consistently and reliably describe the market?
overall_answer.statement: The system is deterministic, source-bound and capable of producing internally inspectable structural evidence. The June review does not prove that it consistently and reliably describes the market. It proves machine reproducibility and, after corrections, a workable review process. External descriptive accuracy and population consistency remain unevaluated.

improvement_priorities: Present a claim-level What-the-system-says versus What-price-did table for every candidate.
Bind every factual claim to exact C1, C2, trigger, price-window and cutoff evidence.
Fail closed on chronology conflicts and explicitly separate pre-trigger persistence from post-trigger candidate duration.
Show assigned medoid, component distance, total distance, outlier threshold, duplicate and overlap status by default.
Expose material contradictory or weakening facts rather than only supporting facts.
Review all promoted objects plus a stratified sample of suppressed candidates and negative controls.
Repeat blinded reviews to measure operator agreement and review stability.
Keep workflow acceptance separate from candidate, family, semantic or market-validity approval.
